title: MAGIC ENGLISH GRADE 7 — WORLD 10: C1 FINAL MASTERY
description: The final Grade 7 mastery world. Learners demonstrate independent C1 performance across complex academic, professional, social, global, and high-pressure real-world communication contexts.

targets.vocabulary: 4500+ active words, advanced collocations, idioms, and register-sensitive language
targets.reading: 2400–3200 words with synthesis, inference, evaluation, tone, stance, and implied meaning
targets.listening: 25–32 minutes of authentic fast-paced, multi-speaker, and mixed-register English
targets.speaking: 30–40 minutes of spontaneous C1 interaction, discussion, negotiation, and problem-solving
targets.writing: 950–1200 words across analytical, persuasive, professional, and reflective tasks
targets.presentation: 15–20 minute presentation with unscripted audience interaction

grammar: Advanced tense and aspect for precise viewpoint, sequencing, and emphasis
Modal and semi-modal systems for deduction, criticism, obligation, probability, and stance
Modal perfects and complex hypothetical structures
Complex passive, reporting, and causative structures
Participial, reduced, and non-finite clause structures
Inversion, fronting, clefting, and marked information structure
Advanced relative clauses, apposition, and complex noun phrases
Ellipsis, substitution, parallelism, reference, and discourse cohesion
Concession, qualification, hedging, boosting, and precise stance control
Register shifting, pragmatics, politeness, and context-sensitive grammar

missions.title: C1 Mastery Activation
missions.focus: Activate the full Grade 7 language system through rapid retrieval, paraphrase, precision, and spontaneous response challenges.

missions.title: Precision Under Pressure
missions.focus: Select exact vocabulary, grammar, tone, and register while responding quickly to changing communication demands.

missions.title: Advanced Conversation Command
missions.focus: Lead and sustain complex conversations, manage turn-taking, clarify meaning, reformulate ideas, and respond naturally.

missions.title: Conflict & Mediation Mastery
missions.focus: Handle disagreement, sensitive issues, complaints, misunderstandings, and competing interests with diplomatic precision.

missions.title: Strategic Decision Lab
missions.focus: Evaluate evidence, compare alternatives, explain consequences, and communicate decisions with carefully controlled certainty.

missions.title: Complex Storytelling Arena
missions.focus: Construct nuanced narratives using advanced aspect, viewpoint, sequencing, emphasis, implication, and descriptive precision.

missions.title: Global Problem-Solving Command
missions.focus: Work through a complex global scenario, identify constraints, challenge assumptions, negotiate priorities, and produce a solution.

missions.title: Negotiation Master Arena
missions.focus: Conduct a multi-stage negotiation using persuasion, concessions, strategic questions, hedging, reframing, and agreement-building.

missions.title: Intercultural Intelligence Lab
missions.focus: Adapt communication strategy across cultures by controlling directness, politeness, assumptions, tone, and relationship-building.

missions.title: High-Stakes Communication Test
missions.focus: Respond effectively to unexpected questions, urgent requests, interviews, complaints, and difficult professional situations.

missions.title: C1 Reading Synthesis Lab
missions.focus: Compare long-form sources, identify assumptions and evidence, evaluate competing viewpoints, and synthesize conclusions.

missions.title: Authentic Listening Mastery
missions.focus: Process natural-speed English with interruptions, reduced forms, multiple accents, changing viewpoints, and implied meaning.

missions.title: Professional Writing Mastery
missions.focus: Produce polished emails, reports, proposals, explanations, and recommendations with precise structure, tone, and register.

missions.title: Critical Argument Forge
missions.focus: Build sophisticated arguments, integrate evidence, address counterarguments, qualify claims, and reach defensible conclusions.

missions.title: C1 Presentation Command
missions.focus: Deliver a substantial presentation with clear structure, rhetorical control, audience adaptation, and unscripted Q&A.

missions.title: Media, Society & Information Lab
missions.focus: Analyze complex media content, framing, rhetoric, evidence, commentary, and competing narratives without losing nuance.

missions.title: Life, Work & Global Simulation
missions.focus: Navigate a sequence of realistic travel, workplace, education, technology, service, and social communication challenges.

missions.title: Independent C1 Mission
missions.focus: Complete an open-ended communication challenge with minimal scaffolding while independently selecting language and strategies.

missions.title: World 10 Final Integrated Marathon
missions.focus: Complete a continuous multi-skill challenge combining advanced vocabulary, grammar, reading, listening, speaking, writing, negotiation, and presentation.

missions.title: WORLD 10 MASTER QUEST — C1 FINAL MASTERY
missions.focus: Complete the ultimate Grade 7 C1 simulation: interpret complex information, solve a real-world problem, negotiate, write a professional response, and present a final solution with unscripted questions.

realWorldScenarios: International travel disruption and service recovery
Advanced job interview and workplace challenge
Media claim analysis and competing viewpoints

assessment.masteryStandard: Learner can communicate independently and effectively in complex academic, professional, social, and global contexts, adapting language, register, tone, structure, and strategy with sustained C1-level control.
